host: Local Windows x64, Ryzen 9 5900X, 12 physical cores / 24 logical processors, RTX 3070
original_solver_source: 00d0f2a2 (9cf0de8 changed only timing results and their README)

conditions.timing: Solver integration wall_s, including per-step response/progress collection; setup, CAD preprocessing and packaging excluded. Processes ran individually, with a 1800 s deadline.
conditions.cpu: OMP_NUM_THREADS is the worker budget. sampled_logical_cores is process user+kernel CPU seconds per elapsed second between the first and last samples with progress strictly between 0 and the last step. The host performance and busy counters are separate.
conditions.checks: Every physical output row compared byte-for-byte with the corresponding same-method prefix or complete pre-optimization trajectory. Tests ran on the same 65,732 Gmsh facets and compiled parts. No historical response was consumed by the solver.
conditions.phases: mesh_detection_s and cad_patch_batch_s are batch wall times. Broad, search, group and area CAD timers sum pair elapsed times and may overlap.
conditions.selection: Short 800-step runs screen thread budgets; 50000-step runs are separate measurements. Times are observations on a shared host and do not bound hardware peak.

variants.new: task arena, triangle predicates, CAD block integration
variants.final: slab clipping, feature witnesses, parallel CAD face pairs; includes trial topology cache
variants.window: local nine-direction BVH, reused CAD roots and transformed nodes
variants.fused: leaf filtering before output; same CAD kernel as window

gpu_online_model: Fixed parallel hinges: triangle gate plus interpolation of precomputed contact wrenches. Same mesh hashes as CPU. GPU physical outputs checked against saved GPU response, excluding timing channels. Different online contact workload from either CPU method.
